headline: Fisherman's Row Swaps Mount While Dead Lands Resumes Base Turnover
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fisherman's Row has redoubled its frantic pace, logging seven strategic base events in the past two hours as fighting continues right up to the wire. The Dead Lands front has also shaken off its brief structural pause, registering two fresh base captures alongside over thirteen hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour window. Meanwhile, the flare-up previously noted in Palantine Berm has completely subsided, with guns falling quiet across the sector. Attritional carnage remains at its fiercest in Weathered Expanse, which absorbed over two thousand casualties in the last two hours despite immovable territorial lines. High combat friction persists across the divided sectors of Linn of Mercy and King's Cage, where casualty counts continue to climb steadily even as strategic base control holds firm. Across Lykos Isle and Stlican Shelf, localized clashes proceed at a subdued rate without further changes in outpost ownership.
